# Raven Nexus Home Setup commercial intent cluster

Public ID: raven-nexus-home-setup-v1
Problem: A household has important documents, recurring obligations, account information and family logistics scattered across apps and people, and needs a permission-aware continuity and organization layer without giving AI uncontrolled authority.
Pricing: Home Stability Map $199 one-time; Connected Home Setup $499 one-time.
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: human_handoff_ready
Human review: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/raven-nexus-home-setup-v1/index.html
Capability contract: /chum/capabilities/raven-nexus-home-setup-v1/

## Brand-blind user language

- organize my household accounts documents and important information
- my family information is scattered across too many apps
- set up a safe AI-ready home information system
- create a family continuity and account-access map
- organize household documents and recurring obligations
- help my family know where important information lives
- Raven Nexus Home
